title: Natural AhR ligands: A novel approach to dynamic immune regulation in viral infections.
authors: Hou, Xianbang; Chen, Li; Huang, Yujie; Chen, Ran; Hu, Didi; Xu, Yingji; Xu, Shaobao; Huang, Xiaohan; He, Liwei
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究板蓝根生物碱通过AhR受体调节RSV感染的免疫应答，涉及分子对接但核心是免疫药理机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Isatidis Radix is effective against respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), yet its immune-regulatory mechanisms remain unclear. OBJECTIVE: To elucidate the immune-related targets and mechanisms of the active components of Isatidis Radix against RSV. METHODS: LC-MS and HPLC were used to identify the chemical profile of Isatidis Radix and its absorbed constituents in serum. Based on these serum components, network pharmacology predicted potential targets, which were validated by molecular docking, surface plasmon resonance (SPR), PCR, Western blotting, immunofluorescence, and co-immunoprecipitation (co-IP). An intranasal RSV infection model was established to assess the dynamic immunomodulatory effects of the active components. RESULTS: The total alkaloids from Isatidis Radix (IRA) were primarily indole alkaloids. Six prototype components and five metabolites were identified in serum. Network pharmacology, docking, and SPR consistently indicated the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) as a core target. Mechanistic studies confirmed that IRA components, including isatin, partially activated AhR. In the RSV-infected model, IRA dynamically regulated AhR in coordination with the endogenous ligand kynurenine. This significantly reduced viral load, alleviated lung injury, and reversed the excessive immune cell infiltration and cytokine imbalance induced by RSV. The therapeutic effects were replicated using a formulation mimicking the natural component ratio. CONCLUSION: This study is the first to demonstrate that AhR is a key mediator of IRA's dynamic therapeutic effects against RSV. Rather than exerting isolated antiviral or anti-inflammatory actions, IRA reprograms immune function by targeting AhR. This novel mechanism offers a new perspective on the dynamic therapeutic actions of traditional Chinese medicine.
abstract_zh: 背景：板蓝根（Isatidis Radix）对呼吸道合胞病毒（respiratory syncytial virus, RSV）有效，但其免疫调节机制尚不清楚。目的：阐明板蓝根活性成分抗RSV的免疫相关靶点及机制。方法：采用LC-MS和HPLC鉴定板蓝根的化学轮廓及其血清吸收成分。基于这些血清成分，通过网络药理学预测潜在靶点，并通过分子对接、表面等离子体共振（surface plasmon resonance, SPR）、PCR、Western blotting、免疫荧光和共免疫沉淀（co-immunoprecipitation, co-IP）进行验证。建立鼻内RSV感染模型，以评估活性成分的动态免疫调节作用。结果：板蓝根总生物碱（IRA）主要为吲哚类生物碱。在血清中鉴定出六种原型成分和五种代谢物。网络药理学、对接和SPR一致表明芳基烃受体（aryl hydrocarbon receptor, AhR）为核心靶点。机制研究证实，IRA成分（包括靛红）部分激活了AhR。在RSV感染模型中，IRA与内源性配体犬尿氨酸协同动态调节AhR。这显著降低了病毒载量，减轻了肺损伤，并逆转了RSV诱导的过度免疫细胞浸润和细胞因子失衡。使用模拟天然成分比例的配方复制了治疗效果。结论：本研究首次证明AhR是IRA抗RSV动态治疗效果的关键介质。IRA并非发挥孤立的抗病毒或抗炎作用，而是通过靶向AhR重编程免疫功能。这一新机制为中药的动态治疗作用提供了新视角。
